translated_title: U.S. Tariffs Do Not Affect Mexico; They Stayed at the 10% That Products Outside the USMCA Already Had: Sheinbaum
original_title: Aranceles de EU no afectan a México; se quedaron en el 10% que ya tenían productos fuera del T-MEC: Sheinbaum
author: Alma E. Muñoz
meta_description: Speaking in Cuernavaca after meeting with U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer, she said rules of origin remain under negotiation.
